form_factor: landscape credit-card-size four-key macro pad with display and microphone

layout.display: LT225C7-C08-03 2.25-inch color LCD rotated into a horizontal strip in the upper front zone
layout.keys: four low-profile mechanical switches in one row below display

details.platform: Seeed Studio XIAO family; exact model owned by BOM stage
details.power: USB bus powered; no battery required for core functions
details.key_behavior: all four keys are programmable macros; factory default assigns one key to microphone mute
details.mute_interaction: one of the four mechanical keys toggles mute and the display shows synchronized state

downstream_decisions.closure_condition: Exact XIAO variant supports required USB HID and USB audio implementation, display, four keys, package fit, and sourcing.
Confirm the exact purchasable LT225C7-C08-03 item plus connector/FPC implementation, pinout, footprint, stock, and PCB/enclosure fit.
Exact microphone and audio interface meet mono USB capture and near-talk clarity requirements.

notes: Confirmed requirements based on the user description, uploaded sketch, structured answers, and the LT225C7-C08-03 datasheet. Credit-card footprint is interpreted as ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1, 85.60 mm x 53.98 mm. Remaining exact implementation parts are owned by the BOM stage with explicit closure conditions.
